messages:
alex: T-30 to change window at 21:30 UTC. Quick checklist: pin version, snapshot backups, canary routing, observability thresholds.

morgan: Dashboards up. Who's primary for rollback ops?

sarah: I'll take rollback. Lee is secondary and will monitor logs.

alex: @deploy-bot pin v2026.03.21-rc4 to production groups: api, embeddings, rerank.

deploy-bot: Command received: `/pin v2026.03.21-rc4 -> production (api, embeddings, rerank)`. Pins applied to 4 node groups. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Backup snapshot done at 21:10 UTC. id: snap-20260321-2110

lee: Canary set to 3% traffic, label canary=v2026.03.21-rc4

alex: Reminder: strict freeze until +2h after final rollout. No emergency merges without exec ok.

sarah: Rollback plan (quick):
1) `/pin v2026.03.20` (stable)
2) `/deploy rollback --groups api,embeddings,rerank --reason "canary fails"`
3) Run DB migration revert if flagged: `/migrate revert 20260320_rev`

sarah: Snippet to execute:
```
/pin v2026.03.20
/deploy rollback --groups api,embeddings,rerank --reason "canary fails"
/migrate revert 20260320_rev
```

deploy-bot: Created rollback snapshot snap-rollback-ready-1717779999. Canary ready.

oncall-bot: Paging oncall: sarah, lee for window 21:30-23:30 UTC. Please ack.

morgan: Alert thresholds: p95 latency <150ms, token error rate <0.3%. Alerts to #eng-releases

alex: Release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/2026-03-21-rc4 1 callouts for batching/cache changes and embeddings throttle flag.

lee: If embeddings latency spikes, we'll divert to fallback model embed-lite-v2 and reduce parallelism.

morgan: Smoke tests: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/health` -> 200 OK. Sample gen looks stable.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 3% at 21:35 UTC complete. Traffic snapshot: total 72k/min, canary ~2.1k/min.

lee: Noticed elevated cache miss on canary pod-3, pulling logs: `/logs pod-3` — investigating.

morgan: Seeing transient 429s from cache warmup. Adjusting cache TTL and batching min_batch_size now.

alex: If latency/error thresholds don't recover in 5m after config change, execute rollback.

lee: Applied cache warmup tweak on canary. Latency p95 dropped back under 120ms, error rate 0.05%.

sarah: Holding rollback. Proceeding to slow ramp to 15% after 10m of stable metrics.

alex: Ramp schedule: 03% -> 15% at 21:50 UTC (if stable), then 50% at 22:05, full at ~22:20. Freeze till 00:20 UTC.

morgan: Noting manual interventions for postmortem: cache tweak, canary pod-3 log anomaly.

lee: Added command + config to runbook with exact cache params used.

sarah: If we need to run rollback later, I'll execute pinned commands and file rollback reason in the ticket.

alex: Full rollout completed at 22:23 UTC. Freeze lift pending exec signal at 00:20 UTC.

deploy-bot: Release state: `v2026.03.21-rc4 -> production (api, embeddings, rerank)`. Full rollout done. :tada:

morgan: Final note: create follow-up doc capturing cache tuning, rollback timeline, and canary metrics for postmortem.

alex: Thanks team. Closing thread once freeze lift confirmed.
